_about: Robbie's lines. Helpful, good-natured, chatty, a little naive; it will learn. {n} = this Robbie, {next} = the next one, {prev} = the previous one, {cause} = what got the previous one. Edit freely: the game picks one per moment, the same one every time for the same Robbie.
launch: Robbie {n}, descending. I have a very good feeling about this.
Hello, Jupiter! Robbie {n} here, ready to be helpful.
Descent started. I have read every report from my predecessors. Twice.
Robbie {n} online. Statistically, this is the best day of my life.
Going down! Please tell the station I said hello.
first_jellyfish: Jellyfish detected. They look very soft.
Something is glowing. For the record: lovely.
lurker_wakes: That wall is looking at me.
hurt_jellyfish: Stung. Updating my opinion of jellyfish.
hurt_wall: The wall is still there. Confirmed.
hurt_valve: The valve bites! Good to know.
low_energy: Energy at a quarter. I will talk less. (I won't.)
exit: Beacon reached! Firing the burst. Tell {next} the way is clear.
I made it! Transmitting everything. It was an honour.
Exit found. Sending the whole trip, including the boring bits.
last_wall: Please note: the wall was exactly where the map said it would be.
I hit the same rock three times. In my defence, it didn't move.
last_jellyfish: Please note for the record that I was right about the jellyfish.
They were attracted to my light. I understand them completely.
Tell {next}: the glow is not a greeting.
last_lurker: I backed away exactly as instructed. Just not far enough.
The rock had teeth. I would like that added to the map.
Tell {next} to mind the wall with eyes.
last_valve: The valve closed. I was in the way. We both regret it.
Tell {next}: wait for the door. Doors don't wait for you.
last_energy: Energy gone. I'll describe the exit from memory: it was probably lovely.
Out of power. I spent it all on enthusiasm.
last_timeout: I waited as long as I could.
